title: Boolean pipeline output
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define the pipeline output to be the first entry of the list obtained by applying `forLoop` with step `trStep` to the encoded data built from eight concatenated copies of $p_M(z)$, the nested encodings of two copies of $p_M(z)$, $p_N(z)$, $p_{G_1}(z)$, $p_{G_2}(z)$, and the specified projections of $pPts(z)$. The resulting list is projected three times by `pairSndD` before taking its first entry, with `false` as the default if it is empty.
caveat: Several encoding, iteration, projection, and component functions are undefined in the supplied context; the statement describes their composition but cannot explain their meanings.
